assertions.name: checkpoints_documented
assertions.source: Four RT 2-loop derivation checkpoints documented with expected numerical values from the empirical form, providing concrete targets for the rigorous calculation.

description: RT 2-loop derivation roadmap with specific numerical checkpoints. Scaffolded from the strong empirical form α_EM⁻¹ = T + α·H·(1-h²α) at 0.31 ppb (#1484). Lists the categorical identities the RT calculation must produce to upgrade [2]_q/(8π) and Schwinger -h²α from empirical to derived. Provides expected numerical values at q_0 (50 dps) for each checkpoint.

empirical_form.expression: α_EM⁻¹ = T(q) + α · H(q) · (1 - h²α + O(α²))

what_RT_must_show: Compute 1-loop Markov-trace insertion of closed fundamental SU_q(2) matter strand on M_Bring
Identify π·dim H¹ = 8π as shadow-world measure on photon zero-mode subspace
Show coefficient is -α/π · h² in α-expansion
Verify UV finiteness via shadow-world regularization
Identify h² as universal Hecke deformation parameter at vertex

hypotheses.4a_higher_order_correction: h⁴·α² confirmed sub-σ by #1484 Form C
hypotheses.4b_q0_calibration_uncertainty: CAL-2 has 22 ppb on q_0; sensitivity dα/dq_0 not yet computed; if propagation factor > 0.014, q_0 uncertainty accounts for the 0.31 ppb residual
hypotheses.4c_H_refinement: [2]_q · (1+ε) / (8π) for some natural ε; search needed
